name: todo-webapp
description: Single-page React app where a signed-in user creates todos, views their own list, and marks todos complete. Talks only to todo-api for data; holds no database credentials itself.

dependencies.name: todo-api
dependencies.description: Backend API this app calls to create todos, list a signed-in user's todos, and mark one complete.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Thunder sign-in for the browser app — OIDC client config used to authenticate the user via PKCE.
